$comment: HIPAA (45 CFR Part 164) → SOC 2 TSC 2017 (rev. 2022) mappings. Written from the CFR text against the AICPA criteria intent. HIPAA + SOC 2 is the most common dual-audit combination for US health-tech, so this cross-walk targets evidence reuse: CC-series for the Security Rule, A-series for contingency, P-series for the Privacy Rule and breach notification.
source: 45 CFR Part 164 cross-walk to AICPA TSC 2017 (rev. 2022)

mappings.rationale: The Security Rule risk analysis is a scoped instance of identifying and analysing risks to objectives.
Risk management selects and develops control activities that mitigate identified risks.
A sanction policy enforces accountability for control responsibilities.
Regular activity review is how anomalies and potential incidents are identified.
Designating a Security Official establishes structure, reporting lines and authority for security.
Workforce clearance supports attracting and retaining competent, trustworthy personnel.
Termination procedures deregister credentials when access is no longer authorized.
Granting ePHI access under policy matches authorizing and modifying access to IT resources.
Establishing, documenting and reviewing access rights is the same access-lifecycle criterion.
Security reminders are internal communication of control responsibilities.
Malware protection procedures map to prevention/detection of unauthorized software.
Incident procedures include evaluating events to determine whether they are incidents and their impact.
Response, mitigation and documentation of incidents parallels incident response and notification.
Documenting outcomes and mitigation feeds root-cause identification and remediation.
Retrievable exact copies of ePHI are the backup infrastructure the availability criterion requires.
A disaster recovery plan with restoration procedures is what recovery-plan testing exercises.
Periodic contingency testing matches recovery-plan tests and result communication.
Periodic evaluations of Security Rule compliance are ongoing/separate control evaluations.
BAA assurances from vendors handling ePHI are vendor risk management.
Facility access control and validation restricts physical access to protected assets.
Final disposition of ePHI media matches discontinuing protection only after data is destroyed.
Unique user identification underpins logical access security architecture.
Encryption of stored ePHI is a logical-access protection over data at rest.
Audit controls generate the monitoring records used to detect security events.
Person/entity authentication is part of the logical access security criterion.
Encrypting ePHI in transit restricts unauthorized access during transmission and movement.
Notifying affected individuals of a breach of unsecured PHI matches breach notification to data subjects; HIPAA fixes the 60-day clock.
HHS notification is regulator breach notification under the same criterion.
BA breach-reporting duties are typically verified through third-party privacy-commitment assessments.
Minimum necessary limits PHI use to identified purposes.
The notice of privacy practices is the privacy notice provided to individuals.
The right of access is handled through the data-subject access process.
Amendment requests and disagreement handling map to correction-request handling.
An accounting of disclosures requires complete and accurate third-party disclosure records.
